svg.title: Protocol: motivation starts it, discipline ships it. 01 Show up every day: a 365-day LeetCode streak. 02 Own it end to end: interface, API, data, deploy, monitoring. 03 Measure, don’t guess. 04 Stay after v1: I run what I build. LeetCode: 865 problems solved (286 easy, 504 medium, 75 hard), 13 badges, 365-day longest streak.
